conflicts.decision: Section 3.5 puts a line manager first on routes up to 25,000.00, while GOV-1.5 says a line manager counts only up to 5,000.00. Read "counts" as the approval that completes the report. Refuse an approve with GOV-1.5 when the last step approver's role limit is below the total, and always above 25,000.00. The ground truth gives the finance reviewer no limit, so use 25,000.00. Confirm with the finance policy team.
GOV-1.3 and a delegate. Treat the person who acts as the person in the step, so a delegate who holds another step of the same report is refused.
